entities.name: Q28017 platelet-activating factor acetylhydrolase
observations: Exact 444-aa sequence match to reviewed Bos taurus UniProt Q28017; annotated calcium-independent lipoprotein-associated phospholipase A2, EC 3.1.1.47.
Hydrolyzes the sn-2 ester of platelet-activating factor (1-O-alkyl-2-acetyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine); also acts on short-chain and oxidized sn-2 phospholipid acyl groups.

entities.name: Boc-protected chlorophenyl mesylate
observations: Documented precursor: CC(=O)OC? The reported mesylate is CC? Structure is BocNH-CH(4-chlorophenyl)-CH2-OMs; reacts with sodium cyanide in DMF at 80 °C for 3 h to afford the nitrile product in 87% yield.

entities.name: Sodium cyanide
observations: Used as cyanide nucleophile in substitution of the primary mesylate precursor.

entities.name: Boc aminonitrile product
observations: Product connectivity is BocNH-CH(4-chlorophenyl)-CH2CN; reported from primary mesylate displacement.
